task: Who is the parent company of Colgate-Palmolive?

merged.claim: Colgate-Palmolive Company has no parent company; it is a standalone/independent publicly traded corporation.

variants.C: Colgate-Palmolive Company has no parent company; it is an independent, publicly traded parent corporation at the top of its corporate group.
variants.F: Colgate-Palmolive Company does not have a parent company; it is a standalone publicly traded corporation.
variants.D: Colgate-Palmolive Company has no parent company; it is a standalone publicly traded corporation, not a subsidiary of a larger corporation.
variants.E: Colgate-Palmolive Company has no parent company; it is an independent, publicly traded company.

merged.claim: Colgate-Palmolive common stock ($1.00 par value) is listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker CL.

variants.C: Colgate-Palmolive common stock ($1.00 par value) is listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker CL.
variants.A: Colgate-Palmolive Company common stock ($1.00 par value) trades on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol CL.
variants.D: Colgate-Palmolive Company's common stock ($1.00 par value) is listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker CL.
variants.F: Colgate-Palmolive Company's common stock ($1.00 par value) is listed on the New York Stock Exchange under ticker CL, per its SEC filing dated October 30, 2026.
variants.E: Colgate-Palmolive is listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker CL.

merged.claim: Colgate-Palmolive files its own fiscal 2025 Form 10-K with the SEC as registrant (Commission File Number 1-644; IRS EIN 13-1815595), so no parent files or reports above it.

variants.C: Colgate-Palmolive files its own Form 10-K with the SEC as registrant for fiscal 2025 (Commission File Number 1-644; IRS EIN 13-1815595), so no parent files or reports above it.

merged.claim: The 2025 Form 10-K (fiscal year ended December 31, 2025) names Colgate-Palmolive Company as the exact name of the registrant.

variants.B: The 2025 Form 10-K (fiscal year ended December 31, 2025) names COLGATE-PALMOLIVE COMPANY as the exact name of the registrant.

merged.claim: The 10-K defines Colgate-Palmolive Company together with its subsidiaries as 'the Company' or 'Colgate-Palmolive'.

variants.A: Colgate-Palmolive's latest Form 10-K (filed 2026-02-23, for fiscal year ended 2025-12-31) identifies Colgate-Palmolive Company as the registrant and defines the Company together with its subsidiaries.
variants.B: The filing defines Colgate-Palmolive Company together with its subsidiaries as "the Company" or "Colgate-Palmolive".

merged.claim: Colgate-Palmolive's principal executive offices are at 200 Park Avenue, New York, NY 10022.

variants.C: Colgate-Palmolive's principal executive offices are at 200 Park Avenue, New York, NY 10022.

merged.claim: Colgate-Palmolive is headquartered in New York, New York.

variants.E: Colgate-Palmolive is headquartered in New York, New York.

merged.claim: Exhibit 21 of the fiscal 2025 10-K, 'Subsidiaries of the Registrant', lists dozens of subsidiaries, e.g. Colgate Oral Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Delaware) and Colgate (Guangzhou) Company Limited (China); Hill's entities are also included.

variants.C: Exhibit 21 of Colgate-Palmolive's fiscal 2025 10-K, titled 'Subsidiaries of the Registrant', lists dozens of subsidiaries it owns, e.g. Colgate Oral Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Delaware) and Colgate (Guangzhou) Company Limited (China); Hill's entities are also included.

merged.claim: The Exhibit 21 subsidiary list is as of December 31, 2025 and changes over time as the company acquires, restructures or dissolves entities.

variants.C: The Exhibit 21 subsidiary list is as of December 31, 2025 and changes over time as the company acquires, restructures or dissolves entities.

merged.claim: Colgate-Palmolive has no single controlling owner; its stock is dispersed among public shareholders and institutional investors.

variants.C: Colgate-Palmolive is a publicly traded corporation with no single controlling owner; its stock is dispersed among public shareholders and institutional investors.

merged.claim: The Vanguard Group holds about 10.05% of Colgate-Palmolive per the 2025 DEF 14A proxy.

variants.C: The Vanguard Group holds about 10.05% of Colgate-Palmolive per the 2025 DEF 14A proxy.

merged.claim: BlackRock holds about 8.0% of Colgate-Palmolive per the 2025 DEF 14A proxy.

variants.C: BlackRock holds about 8.0% of Colgate-Palmolive per the 2025 DEF 14A proxy.

merged.claim: State Street Corporation holds about 5.79% of Colgate-Palmolive per the 2025 DEF 14A proxy.

variants.C: State Street Corporation holds about 5.79% of Colgate-Palmolive per the 2025 DEF 14A proxy.

merged.claim: Vanguard, BlackRock and State Street are passive index-fund managers investing on behalf of fund investors, not a controlling corporate parent; their stakes change each quarter.

variants.C: Vanguard, BlackRock and State Street are passive index-fund managers investing on behalf of fund investors, not a controlling corporate parent; their stakes change each quarter.

merged.claim: Colgate-Palmolive operates together with its subsidiaries and is itself the parent of those subsidiaries.

variants.E: Colgate-Palmolive operates together with its subsidiaries, and is itself the parent of those subsidiaries.

merged.claim: Colgate-Palmolive owns the Hill's pet nutrition brands (Hill's Science Diet, Hill's Prescription Diet) in its Pet Nutrition segment.

variants.E: Colgate-Palmolive owns the Hill's pet nutrition brands (Hill's Science Diet, Hill's Prescription Diet) in its Pet Nutrition segment.

merged.claim: Colgate-Palmolive manufactures and sells consumer products in the United States and internationally.

variants.E: Colgate-Palmolive manufactures and sells consumer products in the United States and internationally.

variants.E: Some local units abroad, such as Colgate-Palmolive (India) Ltd, are subsidiaries whose parent is Colgate-Palmolive Company.

c1.note: Colgate-Palmolive is the top-level registrant with no controlling owner, so it has no parent company.

c5.note: The cover pages of the 10-K and the Q3 2026 10-Q both list common stock at $1.00 par under CL on the NYSE.

c6.note: The 10-K cover shows Delaware as the state of incorporation.

c7.note: The cover page shows File No. 1-644 and EIN 13-1815595, with Colgate-Palmolive as registrant.

c8.note: The 10-K gives COLGATE-PALMOLIVE COMPANY as the exact name of the registrant for the year ended 2025-12-31.

c9.note: This is standard 10-K wording, and the consolidation note covers the Company and its subsidiaries; the exact definition sentence was not in the passages.

c10.note: The 10-K lists the principal executive offices at 300 Park Avenue, not 200 Park Avenue.

c11.note: The principal executive offices are in New York, NY.

c12.note: Exhibit 21 lists both named subsidiaries and several Hill's entities.

c13.note: Exhibit 21 belongs to the FY2025 10-K and is a point-in-time list; the claim that it changes over time is general.

c14.note: Ownership is dispersed across institutions, with the largest holder near 10%, and no controlling owner.

c15.note: The page cites the 2025 DEF 14A for Vanguard at 10.05%; the figure comes from last year's proxy, so it may be outdated.

c16.note: Passage reports BlackRock 8.0% citing the 2025 DEF 14A; context on shareholders, not a parent, and figure is dated to the 2025 proxy.

c17.note: Passage reports State Street 5.79% citing the 2025 DEF 14A; context only, figure dated.

c18.note: Colgate is publicly traded with no controlling owner; institutional holders invest on behalf of fund investors, so there is no parent company. 'Passive index-fund' is a slight generalization but substantively fine.

c19.note: The 10-K Exhibit 21 lists Colgate-Palmolive's subsidiaries, and the consolidation note covers its majority-owned subsidiaries, so it is the parent, not a subsidiary.

c20.note: FY2025 10-K confirms Hill's Science Diet and Prescription Diet in the Pet Nutrition segment.

c21.note: Company description states it manufactures and sells consumer products in the US and internationally.

c22.note: Exhibit 21 lists Colgate-Palmolive (India) Limited with an asterisk as a subsidiary of the registrant; the parent is Colgate-Palmolive Company.

c13.note: Exhibit 21 to Colgate's FY2025 10-K (filed 2026, file name 'exhibit2112312025'). The page has no explicit 'as of' date, so the date is inferred. Saying the list changes over time is a general point, not from the filing.

c15.note: Vanguard's 13G/A shows 10.05% as of 1/31/2025 (82,189,533 shares). The 2025 proxy table itself could not be read. Not current: per search results the 2026 proxy shows 10.26%, and after a Jan 2026 reorganization Vanguard Group reports 0% and Vanguard Capital Management 7.52%.
